revelations.name: Burning Magic
revelations.summary: Fire spells ignite damaged creatures.

revelations.name: Cinder Dance
revelations.summary: Move faster and master difficult terrain; incompatible with the lame curse.

revelations.name: Fire Breath
revelations.summary: Breathe a scaling cone of flame.

revelations.name: Firestorm
revelations.summary: Create a devastating storm of fire.

revelations.name: Form of Flame
revelations.summary: Transform into a fire elemental.

revelations.name: Gaze of Flames
revelations.summary: See through and eventually scry through fire.

revelations.name: Heat Aura
revelations.summary: Radiate damaging heat around yourself.

revelations.name: Molten Skin
revelations.summary: Gain scaling fire resistance and immunity.

revelations.name: Touch of Flame
revelations.summary: Burn creatures by touch and empower weapons with flame.

revelations.name: Wings of Fire
revelations.summary: Fly on wings of living flame.

mysteries.finalRevelation: Master fire completely: apply Enlarge Spell, Extend Spell, Silent Spell, or Still Spell to any fire spell without increasing its level or casting time.

revelations.name: Awesome Display
revelations.summary: Pattern spells affect creatures as though their Hit Dice were lower.

revelations.name: Coat of Many Stars
revelations.summary: Conjure scaling armor of starlight.

revelations.name: Dweller in Darkness
revelations.summary: Summon a terrifying alien presence.

revelations.name: Guiding Star
revelations.summary: Gain celestial guidance beneath the night sky.

revelations.name: Interstellar Void
revelations.summary: Expose a foe to freezing interstellar darkness.

revelations.name: Lure of the Heavens
revelations.summary: Leave no trail, hover, and eventually fly.

revelations.name: Mantle of Moonlight
revelations.summary: Enrage a creature with a touch and ward against lycanthropes.

revelations.name: Moonlight Bridge
revelations.summary: Create a scaling bridge of moonlight.

revelations.name: Spray of Shooting Stars
revelations.summary: Blast nearby creatures with starry bursts.

revelations.name: Star Chart
revelations.summary: Consult the heavens for answers as commune.

mysteries.finalRevelation: Become one with the heavens: add Charisma to all saving throws, stabilize automatically, gain fear immunity, confirm critical hits automatically, and return to life three days after death.
